caption: The drawing consists of a single object, a teapot, depicted in a straightforward, side profile view. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with two horizontal bands dividing its surface. It features a prominent, curved spout on the left side and a large, ornate handle on the right, both with smooth, flowing lines. The lid is dome-shaped with a small knob on top, and the base is wide and slightly flared. The lines of the drawing are thin, precise, and rendered in black, while the background is plain and uncolored, leaving the paper a light, off-white shade. The entire teapot and its features are enclosed within a square border that is centered on the page. Near the lower right corner of the paper, outside the border, there is a small signature: “H. Granet.”
title: Pewter Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
